about: Case and Unicode spellings of security paths, for dork-labs/dorkos to copy as-is (its #3191) so both repos test the same list.

Every path in `match` must count as a built-in security path when folded at least as broadly as a case-insensitive disk does (at least `normalize('NFKC')` and `toLowerCase()`); no path in `noMatch` may.
